# Synthetic Sentinel feasibility fixtures

These are inert, original source lessons for PR 01. They are not production application code and must not
be installed, built, imported or executed. No Sentinel package/runtime is defined by this directory.

`cases.json` maps every `.fixture` blob to a temporary source path, gives exact SHA-256 values, and records
independent expected inventory, parser candidates, exclusions and scoped security facts. Generated entries
describe oversize, symbolic and missing inputs. `gitIndex` requests tracked-state materialization in a
disposable repository; the harness must retain evidence rather than infer tracking from the label.

Real manifests, lockfiles, ignore files and workflows are stored under fixture-only names. Materialize
ecosystem names only in temporary trees. The candidate dependency declarations are incomplete and uninstalled;
their versions carry no support or advisory claim. Rule blobs are original narrow syntax locators. Labels
await independent review and do not certify runtime protection.

See the [protocol](../../../../../docs/proposals/farsight-sentinel/feasibility-protocol.md) for the E1–E8
controls, hash scheme, denominator and measurement/demo procedure. The lead's results record distinguishes
preparation, actual local probes, gated scanner trials and future production gates.
